tools.name: audit_listing
tools.description: Full dataset audit of a listing ($0.04 after the one-time free trial, or pass). Args: listing, siblings (or listing_url).

tools.name: query_verdict
tools.description: Precomputed signed verdict for a dataset ($0.01). Args: dataset_id, optional manifest_hash + shared_line_hash for manifest-change-trigger checking.

tools.name: verify_verdict
tools.description: Verify an Ed25519-signed verdict (free). Args: signed_verdict.
